title: Transactions and Data Integrity
introduction: Transactions group related operations so observers do not see a partially completed update.
learningOutcomes: Recognise consistency risks from concurrent updates.

activities.question: A transfer debits one account but cannot credit the other. What should an atomic transaction do?
activities.explanation: Atomicity makes the related changes succeed together or have no effect.

activities.question: Two concurrent updates can overwrite one another without suitable coordination.
activities.explanation: A lost update occurs when both operations read old state and one later overwrites the other's result.

activities.question: An operation safe to repeat without applying the effect twice is ___.
activities.explanation: Idempotency makes retries safer after uncertain failures.
